messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Jul 2025 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: MAP skeleton + 60-day close accelerator

Hi Samira —

Thanks again for the time today. As promised, I pulled together a lightweight MAP skeleton and a companion 60-day close outline to make the run to pilot as predictable as possible. The doc is intentionally short: stakeholder owners, decision milestones, gating criteria, and a suggested demo/POC timeline.

What I uploaded:
- MAP starter (Google Doc) — editable for you and your technical/infosec reviewers
- 60-day close outline (one-pager slide PDF) — quick view for execs

Primary asks:
1) Can you take a pass on the stakeholder RACI (tab near the top) and confirm owners?
2) Any hard constraints on procurement or security timelines we should bake in?
3) Is a 60-day pilot window still the right target, or should we plan for a longer evaluation?

Links/attachments: prima_map_starter_gdoc_link.txt (contains the GDoc link), 60d-close-outline-slides.pdf (attached).

Proposed next step: 30-min kickoff next Tue morning for the tech team + project sponsor. If that works, I’ll send a calendar invite with a short agenda (demo, security checklist, success metrics).

Thanks — looking forward to iterating.

—Connor

From: Samira Khan <samira@primahealth.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP skeleton + 60-day close accelerator

Connor —

Really appreciate the quick turnaround and the concise format. A few quick notes after a 15-min read and an internal sync: 

• Timeline: Procurement at PrimaHealth typically needs a 4–6 week legal review for new vendors + an additional 1–2 weeks for contract signatures. That bumps the effective start of any pilot unless we do a short-term MSA exception.
• Security: We need a short security evidence pack (SOC 2 summary + data retention commitments). Can Redwood provide a one-page summary and a contact for a detailed questionnaire?
• Stakeholders: Please add Amy Rodriguez (Head of Data Engineering) to the RACI — she’ll own infra sign-off. I’ll loop her if we lock the kickoff.

If we can fast-track an exec 1:1 for approvals and get a one-page evidence pack, the 60-day window is still plausible but might slip by ~2 weeks.

Can you update the MAP with the procurement gate and a target sign-off date? If you want, I can also share a short procurement checklist from our side.

Thanks — Samira
Samira Khan
VP, Product & Data | PrimaHealth
samira@primahealth.com | +1 617-555-0144

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Jul 2025 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP skeleton + 60-day close accelerator

Hi Samira / Connor —

Looping in with a couple of practical tweaks from a Customer Success perspective: 

1) Success milestones — I added three measurable QCs to the MAP:
  - Integration smoke test (saml/auth + minimal data flow) — owner: Amy / Data Eng (week 1)
  - Latency & throughput signoff on a representative workload (baseline + 95th pct) — owner: CS / Infra (week 2–3)
  - Qualitative eval: 3 product use cases validated by product team (week 3–6)

2) Risk & mitigations — added an early-fallback to a 14-day technical spike if procurement pushes pilot start. That keeps engineering momentum and gives us concrete logs for the SEC review.

3) Evidence pack — we have a templated SOC 2 summary and an answer set for standard security questionnaires. Connor, I can attach the one-pager here (I’ll add to the GDoc too).

Connor — I made these inline comments in the doc (see comment thread labeled CS: milestones). If Samira confirms Amy as the infra owner, I’ll mark the RACI as pending and we’ll set the kickoff.

—Marissa

Samira —

Thanks — I updated the MAP with a procurement gate and tentative sign-off dates, moved the pilot start out two weeks to reflect the legal window, and pinned the fallback 14-day tech spike as Marissa suggested. I also attached the SOC 2 one-pager (see attachments) and added Marissa’s CS checklist into the doc.

Next actions:
- Amy (cc’d) — can you confirm ownership of infra signoff? If yes, we’ll lock the RACI and send a 30-min kickoff invite for Tue 15 July 10:00–10:30 PT.
